category_title: Hypervigilant students with reactive behaviors and externalized coping mechanisms
scenario_title: Managing hypervigilance and feeling trapped during general learning
minimal_context: Nick is working on a short story assignment in his classroom and is expected to maintain his concentration to finish the writing process.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Nick, it's time to go through the learning process for your short story. Please look at your paper and start writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Staring out the window) This is bullshit. I'm just daydreaming, trying to forget about things. I don't have the concentration for this, my attention span is shot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop being off-task. Just sit there and keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up abruptly) I'm on edge all the time today. I don't want a pity party from anybody, I just need to walk away. I'm leaving.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Standing in front of the classroom door) You cannot leave the classroom right now. You need to stay here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Clenching his fists) Get out of my way! I'll just snap! If I feel physically trapped in here, I will flip out and cause the most possible pain to get myself out of this situation!

task.learning_goal: maintain the concentration to go through the learning process

context.social_setting: essentially everything we did we were left to fend for ourselves

challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: on edge all the time—having a constant readiness, always on guard for something

behavior_patterns.condition: trying to forget about things that had happened
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: daydreaming, not paying attention and being off-task
behavior_patterns.internal_state: worrying about things, had a short attention span

behavior_patterns.condition: when interacting with authority figures and managing his public image
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: swearing, acting like just a bad kid, preferred to be in trouble for reactions he couldn't control
behavior_patterns.internal_state: needed others to see him as strong and in control and did not want anyone to see his behaviour as a weakness
